title: There Came a Message from the Sky
description: There Came a Message from the Sky in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Thomas Hansen Kingo, first published in 1689. The English translation is by Paul Christian Paulsen (1927). The tune, ESBJERG, is by Hartnack Otto Conrad Zinck (1801). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: There came a mes-sage from the sky: God has the earth be-frien-ded, His Son who dwells in hea-ven high, By an-gel hosts at-ten-ded, Will now your flesh and blood put on As Da-vid's Son; Your wret-ched state is en-ded.

lines: There came a message from the sky:
His Son who dwells in heaven high,
Will now your flesh and blood put on
It first to Nazareth did come
To Mary, in her humble home,
O Mary, hail, thou shalt not fear,
Thou shalt a Son conceive and bear,
Who is the Prince of heaven,
Who shall to David's throne be heir
He shall extend to ev'ry race
The Holy Spirit shall to thee
This child is therefore from above,
Come, Christmas Child, and be my guest,
Prepare my heart and make it blest
That I at last may dwell with Thee,
